# Relay

> Relay is an AI phone call assistant for iPhone. A user tells Relay what they need, Relay calls the real business while identifying itself as an AI assistant, and the app returns the available outcome and details. Outcomes depend on the business answering and agreeing.

Official site: {{ORIGIN}}/
Official App Store listing: {{APP_STORE_URL}}
